implementation_notes: Prefer plain functions and modules over classes, state-management libraries and build-time magic. `fetch` + async/await before an HTTP client framework; `Map`/`Set` before a state library; a plain object before a class instance.
idiom_name: plain functions + modules, framework only when the need is real
pitfalls: Redux-style boilerplate for local component state
Wrapping fetch in a generic request layer with one caller
Optional chaining chains that hide which branch actually runs
